description:
Seeker is an on-chain job board on the Starknet ecosystem. Effortlessly create, apply for, and search jobs in one unified platform. Secure, decentralized, and user-friendly, Seeker revolutionizes job hunting and recruitment in the blockchain space. With a focus on transparency and efficiency, Seeker ensures that all job postings and applications are securely recorded on the blockchain, providing verifiable proof of transactions and interactions.

Seeker offers a seamless experience for both job seekers and employers. Job seekers can easily browse through a wide range of job listings, apply for positions that match their skills, and track the status of their applications. Employers can post job openings, review applications, and manage recruitment processes with ease. The platform also supports the creation and application for bounties, incentivizing users to contribute to specific tasks or projects.

Built with a modern tech stack including Next.js, TypeScript, and Cairo, Seeker leverages the best tools for web development and smart contract programming. The integration of Next-Auth allows for secure and straightforward user authentication, while React Hot Toast provides instant notifications, enhancing the overall user experience.

By utilizing Starknet’s blockchain infrastructure, Seeker ensures that all interactions are decentralized and tamper-proof. This decentralized approach eliminates the need for intermediaries, reducing costs and increasing trust between job seekers and employers. Whether you're looking for a full-time position, a part-time gig, or a bounty to tackle, Seeker is your go-to platform for blockchain-based job opportunities.
how_its_made: Seeker is built using a combination of cutting-edge technologies and thoughtful design patterns. Next.js powers our front-end and back-end integration, Cairo ensures secure smart contract development, and Starknet provides a robust blockchain infrastructure. Partner technologies like Next-Auth and React Hot Toast enhance the user experience, while our innovative implementations in contract logic, dynamic routing, and session management make Seeker a reliable and user-friendly platform for decentralized job postings and bounties
